name: 新东方 Vocabulary 6000
description: 新东方词汇进阶 Vocabulary 6000，按原书 Lesson 1–31 编排，共 1240 个词。

sentences.c: Players have to abide by the referee's decision.
sentences.cn: 参赛者必须遵守裁判的判定。

sentences.c: Many people can't abide the smell of cheap cigars.
sentences.cn: 许多人没法忍受廉价雪茄的气味。

sentences.c: The warm December weather in Beijing is abnormal.
sentences.cn: 在北京，12月份还这么暖和是不正常的。

etymology.d: ab（不）+ norm（标准）+ al → 不标准的 → 异常的

sentences.c: Slavery was abolished in the United States after the Civil War.
sentences.cn: 美国在南北战争以后废除了奴隶制。

sentences.c: There is a road with many abrupt turns.
sentences.cn: 那儿有一条路有很多急转弯。

sentences.c: Abrupt responses often cause hurt feelings.
sentences.cn: 无礼的回答通常会伤害别人的感情。

sentences.c: It is absurd to wear a coat at the swimming pool.
sentences.cn: 在游泳池边穿着外套很可笑。

etymology.d: ab + surd（笨）→ 笨的 → 可笑的

sentences.c: My father was born in Germany and still speaks English with a German accent.
sentences.cn: 我的父亲出生在德国，他在说英语的时候仍带着德国口音。

sentences.c: In the word“wonderful”, the accent is on the first syllable.
sentences.cn: 单词wonderful的重音在第一个音节上。

sentences.c: Her new car has many accessories, including air conditioning.
sentences.cn: 她的新车有许多配套设施，包括空调。

trans.cn: ① 容纳，为…提供空间；供应（膳宿）

sentences.c: That hotel can accommodate up to one hundred guests.
sentences.cn: 那家旅馆总共可以容纳100个客人。

sentences.c: I will accommodate my scheme to yours.
sentences.cn: 我会调整我的计划以适应你的计划。

etymology.d: ac（朝向）+ commodate（使合适，方便）→ 使适应；调节

sentences.c: The hungry and tired child was activated when he saw the bread.
sentences.cn: 这个又饿又累的孩子一看见面包马上变得精神起来。

trans.cn: ② 剧烈的；严重的；紧要关头的

sentences.c: Acute hearing helps most animals sense the approach of thunderstorms long before people do.
sentences.cn: 大多数动物都有着灵敏的听觉，它们比人类感知雷雨到来的时间要早很多。

sentences.c: With the acceleration of industrial growth came acute urban crowding and accompanying social stress.
sentences.cn: 随着工业化的加速发展，城市里出现了严重拥挤和随之而来的社会压力。

etymology.d: acu（尖）+ te → 尖锐的 → 敏锐的

sentences.c: Mud adheres to your shoes.
sentences.cn: 你的鞋粘上泥了。

sentences.c: In China, many people adhere to Confucius' teaching.
sentences.cn: 在中国，有很多人遵循孔子的教育理念。

sentences.c: The house adjacent to ours has been sold, so we have a new neighbor.
sentences.cn: 我们隔壁的房子已经卖出去了，于是我们有了新的邻居。

etymology.d: ad + jacent（躺）→ 躺在附近 → 邻近的

sentences.c: It took Janet more than half a year to adjust to the new business after she changed her job.
sentences.cn: 珍妮特跳槽以后，花了多半年的时间来适应这份新工作。

sentences.c: The British administered Hong Kong until 1997.
sentences.cn: 英国对香港的管辖持续到1997年。

sentences.c: In his adolescent years, the successful businessman claimed, he had undergone many hardships.
sentences.cn: 这位成功的商人说，他在青少年时期受过很多的磨难。

etymology.d: adol（成年）+ escent（开始…的）→ 开始成年的 → 青春期的

trans.cn: （尤指不寻常的人或事的）出现，到来

sentences.c: The advent of e-mail changed communication.
sentences.cn: 电子邮件的出现改变了通信方式。

etymology.d: ad + vent（到来）→ 出现，到来

sentences.c: The adverse effects from most of the medication were minimal.
sentences.cn: 大多数药物的副作用很小。

sentences.c: The International Fund for Animal Welfare was a strong advocate of the campaign to save dolphins from death.
sentences.cn: 国际爱护动物基金会是拯救海豚运动的坚决拥护者。

sentences.c: Some people advocated limiting the number of cars on the main road.
sentences.cn: 有些人倡议限制主路上的汽车数量。

sentences.c: The new building has little aesthetic value, but can accommodate a lot of people.
sentences.cn: 这座新楼没有多少美学价值，不过可以容纳很多人。

sentences.c: The hospital is affiliated with a local university.
sentences.cn: 这家医院是当地一所大学的附属医院。

etymology.d: af + fili（儿子）+ ate → 使成为儿子 → 使隶属

sentences.c: She affirmed before the policeman that he was the one who stole her purse.
sentences.cn: 她在警察面前坚称他就是偷她钱包的那个人。

sentences.c: The post office affirmed that the letter was delivered.
sentences.cn: 邮局证实信已寄出。

sentences.c: The villagers in several mountainous areas are afflicted by poverty in the nation.
sentences.cn: 在这个国家，一些山区的村民深受穷困之苦。

etymology.d: af + flict（打击）→ 一再受到打击 → 折磨

sentences.c: My agenda is quite full for the whole week, so I can't make an appointment with you.
sentences.cn: 这个星期我的日程已经排得很满了，所以我没有时间跟你会面了。

sentences.c: Mary aggravated her injuries by refusing treatment.
sentences.cn: 由于玛丽拒绝接受治疗，她的伤情加重了。

etymology.d: ag + grav（重）+ ate → 加重

sentences.c: Because of her agitation over losing her job, she could not sleep.
sentences.cn: 由于失业让她很焦虑，她都睡不着觉了。

sentences.c: Listening to my neighbor practice the piano is an agony.
sentences.cn: 听我的邻居练习钢琴是一件很痛苦的事。

etymology.d: agon（挣扎）+y → 拼命挣扎 → 极大的痛苦

trans.cn: ①（指计划等）使人愉快的，合意的
② 和蔼可亲的，容易相处的

sentences.c: The plan was agreeable to everyone but Mary.
sentences.cn: 除了玛丽，所有人都对这个计划满意。

sentences.c: Mr. Bao is an agreeable man with a kind smile.
sentences.cn: 包先生是一个面带微笑、十分随和的人。

etymology.d: agree（赞同）+ able → 表示同意的 → 合意的

sentences.c: When I first went to New York, it all felt very alien to me.
sentences.cn: 当我第一次去纽约的时候，那里的一切对我来说都很陌生。

sentences.c: Although he has no proof, this man alleges that the janitor stole his watch.
sentences.cn: 尽管没有证据，这个男人还是断言是看门人偷了他的表。

sentences.c: To alleviate symptoms, you should drink plenty of water and stay in bed.
sentences.cn: 为缓解症状，你需要多喝水，卧床休息。

etymology.d: al + lev（轻）+ iate → 减轻

sentences.c: The federal government allocated millions of dollars for cancer research.
sentences.cn: 联邦政府拨出几百万美元用于癌症研究。

sentences.c: Private cars are banned from the city on alternate days.
sentences.cn: 私家车每隔一天就被禁止入城。

sentences.c: If that business does not make what we want, we can always find an alternate one that does.
sentences.cn: 如果那项业务达不到我们想要的水平，我们随时都可以选择其他的业务来替代。

sentences.c: Her cheerfulness alternated with despair.
sentences.cn: 她的欢乐和绝望交替而来。

sentences.c: His ambiguous statements could have been understood in more than one way.
sentences.cn: 他含糊不清的陈述可能让人有不止一种理解方式。

etymology.d: ambi（双，两个）+ gu（= go 走）+ ous → 有两种意义的 → 歧义的，含糊的

trans.cn: 有雄心的，渴望成功的；有野心的

sentences.c: She has some ambitious expansion plans for her business.
sentences.cn: 她的事业拓展计划野心勃勃。

etymology.d: ambi（多于一的）+ tious → 志向多的 → 有雄心的

sentences.c: Rather than amend the club's constitution again, let us discard it and start afresh.
sentences.cn: 与其再次修改俱乐部的章程，我们还不如把它废弃，制定新的章程。

etymology.d: a + mend（补，修）→ 修订

sentences.c: She received ample compensation for her injuries from this accident.
sentences.cn: 她在这起交通事故中所受到的伤害获得了足够的赔偿。

sentences.c: They needed the radio signal to be amplified in order to receive it properly.
sentences.cn: 他们需要增强广播信号以便更好地接收。

sentences.c: He drew an analogy between the brain and a computer.
sentences.cn: 他打了个比方，把人脑比作电脑。

sentences.c: He has a very analytical mind and always gets the highest score in his geometry course.
sentences.cn: 他的分析能力很强，总是在几何学课程中得最高分。

sentences.c: Sometimes, the newspaper publishes anonymous articles in the political opinion section.
sentences.cn: 有时候，报纸在政治观点版刊登匿名文章。

etymology.d: an + onym（名称）+ ous → 无名称的 → 匿名的

sentences.c: Scientists are keen to track the fortunes of Antarctic plant life over 30 million years.
sentences.cn: 科学家热衷于追踪3000万年以来南极地区植物的生长情况的宝贵信息。

sentences.c: The protection of the Antarctic from commercial exploitation is an important goal of environmentalists.
sentences.cn: 保护南极地区不被商业开发是环保人士重要的工作目标。

sentences.c: This dictionary has an appendix which lists computer terms.
sentences.cn: 这本字典有一个列举计算机术语的附录。

sentences.c: She had her appendix out last summer.
sentences.cn: 去年夏天，她做了阑尾切除手术。

sentences.c: The audience stood up and applauded at the end of the concert.
sentences.cn: 音乐会结束时，观众们起立鼓掌。

trans.cn: ② 施用，运用；作用，影响

sentences.c: Application must be made early for the banquet.
sentences.cn: 宴会的邀请必须早点发出。

sentences.c: Mathematics has applications in science.
sentences.cn: 数学在科学领域有所应用。

sentences.c: Fifty thousand dollars would be a fair appraisal of their new house.
sentences.cn: 给他们的新房估价5万美元是客观公正的。

trans.cn: （数量或变化等）很大的；值得重视的

sentences.c: There has been an appreciable drop in the number of the unemployed since the new government came to power.
sentences.cn: 新政府执政以后，失业人员的数量有了明显下降。

etymology.d: ap + preci（赞扬）+ able → 值得赞扬的 → 值得重视的

sentences.c: The English test caused me a lot of apprehension because I did not study hard for it.
sentences.cn: 因为我没有努力学习，英语测试让我感到很恐惧。

sentences.c: His apt reply to the question showed that he had understood it very well.
sentences.cn: 他对这个问题做出的恰当的回答表明他已经理解得很好了。

sentences.c: A careless person is apt to make mistakes.
sentences.cn: 粗心的人容易犯错误。

sentences.c: The crowd watched as the ball rose in a high arc and fell behind the boundary line.
sentences.cn: 观众们看着球划了一条高弧线，然后落在了边界线之外。

sentences.c: The Arctic Circle is an imaginary line drawn at approximately 66.5 degrees North.
sentences.cn: 北极圈是在北纬66.5度附近划的一个假想的圈。

sentences.c: I'm trying to arrange my work so that I can have a couple of days off next week.
sentences.cn: 我尽量安排好工作，好在下周请几天假。

sentences.c: Every morning, Janet arranged the papers on her desk and then began work.
sentences.cn: 每天早上，珍妮特都要整理好桌上的文件，然后开始工作。

sentences.c: The designer displayed an array of new fashions.
sentences.cn: 设计师展示了一系列新的流行服饰。

trans.cn: 清楚地讲话，清晰地发音
善于言辞的，表达清晰的

sentences.c: People learning a foreign language often have difficulty in articulating certain sounds.
sentences.cn: 人们在学习一门外语的时候，经常在发某些音时比较困难。

sentences.c: At the age of 93, he was still sharp-witted and articulate.
sentences.cn: 他93岁了，仍然思维敏捷，表达清晰。

etymology.d: articul（接合）+ ate →（语言）连接得好 → 说话清楚的

sentences.c: They slowly ascended the steep mountain.
sentences.cn: 他们慢慢地爬上了这座陡峭的山。

etymology.d: a + scend（爬）→ 爬上 → 攀登

sentences.c: I ascertained that no one could overhear us before I told Bob the news.
sentences.cn: 我确定没有人偷听我们讲话，然后才把这个消息告诉鲍勃。

etymology.d: as + certain（肯定的）→ 可以肯定的 → 确定

sentences.c: John ascribed his success to hard work.
sentences.cn: 约翰把他的成功归功于努力工作。

trans.cn: ①（问题等的）方面；（事物的）一部分

sentences.c: The one aspect of the case that puzzled me was why he had committed the crime.
sentences.cn: 这个案子让我感到困惑的一点是，他为什么要犯罪。

sentences.c: From the cost aspect, the product is not expensive.
sentences.cn: 从成本角度来看，这个产品不贵。

sentences.c: The man was charged with sexual assault.
sentences.cn: 这个男人被指控性侵犯。

etymology.d: as（一再）+ sault（瀑布，急流）→ 一再像瀑布一样冲击 → 袭击

sentences.c: The lawyer asserts that his client is not guilty.
sentences.cn: 律师坚称他的委托人无罪。

etymology.d: as + sert（参与）→ 一再参与（讨论）→ 主张

trans.cn: ② 分配；（财产、权力等）转让

sentences.c: I have a lot of reading assignments to complete before the end of the term.
sentences.cn: 我有许多阅读作业要在期末前完成。

sentences.c: The assignment of the property will take place tomorrow.
sentences.cn: 产权转让将在明天进行。

trans.cn: ② 吃，吸收（食物或营养）

sentences.c: You'll need to assimilate all Einstein's work before doing this research.
sentences.cn: 在进行这项研究之前，你需要学习一下爱因斯坦所有的研究成果。

sentences.c: People assimilate nutrients from food.
sentences.cn: 人们从食物中吸收营养。

etymology.d: as + simil（相同）+ ate → 使相同 → 同化

sentences.c: I was astonished by the news of the divorce—they seemed so happy together.
sentences.cn: 我听到他们离婚的消息时感到很震惊——他们在一起看起来很幸福。

sentences.c: Astronomy is the scientific study of the universe as a whole and of objects which exist naturally in space, such as the moon, the sun, planets and stars.
sentences.cn: 天文学是一项针对整个宇宙以及自然存在于宇宙内的天体，如月球、太阳、行星和恒星的科学研究。

trans.cn: 大气；大气层；（某一地的）空气

sentences.c: The atmospheres of Mars and Earth are very different.
sentences.cn: 火星和地球的大气层差别很大。

sentences.c: The prince was followed by five or six attendants.
sentences.cn: 王子的后面跟着五六个随从。

sentences.c: Coughing and sneezing are some of the attendant discomforts of a cold.
sentences.cn: 咳嗽和打喷嚏都是由感冒引起的不适感。

sentences.c: The old man sought to augment his wealth by placing it in a bank.
sentences.cn: 老人想通过把钱存入银行来使自己的财富增值。

etymology.d: aug（提高）+ ment → 提高 → 增大

trans.cn: 真的，真迹的；可靠的，确实的

sentences.c: This discovery is an authentic Goya drawing.
sentences.cn: 这次发现的这幅画是戈雅的真迹。

etymology.d: aut（= auto 自己）+ hent（做）+ ic → 自己做的 → 真的

sentences.c: Congress authorized the spending of money for a new post office.
sentences.cn: 议会授权拨款新建一座邮局大厦。

sentences.c: In the future, many human workers may be replaced by automatons.
sentences.cn: 未来许多人类的工作可能将由机器人来替代完成。

etymology.d: auto（自己）+ mat（动）+ on → 自己会动的人 → 机器人

sentences.c: The thirteen original U.S. colonies won their autonomy after the American Revolution.
sentences.cn: 在美国独立战争之后，原先的13个殖民地赢得了自治权。

etymology.d: auto（自己）+ nomy（统治）→ 自己统治 → 自治

sentences.c: The driver averted an accident by a quick turn of the steering wheel.
sentences.cn: 驾驶员迅速地打方向盘，避免了一起交通事故。

etymology.d: a + vert（转）→ 转开 → 避免

sentences.c: Bob likes planes very much. He is interested in aviation.
sentences.cn: 鲍勃很喜欢飞机。他对航空学感兴趣。

etymology.d: avi（鸟，渴望）+ ation → 模仿鸟的飞行 → 航空

sentences.c: The earth revolves around the axis which joins the North and South Poles.
sentences.cn: 地球围绕连接北极和南极的轴旋转。

sentences.c: Janet has a Bachelor of Engineering degree.
sentences.cn: 珍妮特有工学学士学位。

sentences.c: Before the wedding, he held a party with all his bachelor friends.
sentences.cn: 在举行婚礼之前，他和他所有的单身汉朋友办了一个派对。

sentences.c: The Red Cross badge is a red cross on a white background.
sentences.cn: 红十字会的标志是一个在白色背景上的红色十字。

sentences.c: The absence of clues baffled the police in the investigation of the murder.
sentences.cn: 线索的缺乏阻碍了警察调查这起谋杀案。

sentences.c: How much baggage can we take on the plane?
sentences.cn: 我们能带多少行李上飞机？

sentences.c: At twenty he was already going bald.
sentences.cn: 他20岁时就开始秃顶了。

sentences.c: A ballet tells a story through the movements of the dancing and is accompanied by music often written specially for it.
sentences.cn: 芭蕾舞通过舞蹈动作讲述故事，并且配有通常专门为其创作的音乐。

sentences.c: She offered to put a bandage on his arm.
sentences.cn: 她主动提出为他包扎手臂。

sentences.c: The recession had led to many small businesses going bankrupt.
sentences.cn: 经济萧条导致许多小公司破产。

sentences.c: Foolish expenditures will bankrupt the company.
sentences.cn: 胡乱花钱会导致公司破产。

etymology.d: bank（银行）+ rupt（断）→ 从银行断了来源的 → 破产的

sentences.c: It's time you went to the barber 's.
sentences.cn: 你该去理发了。

sentences.c: She was barely fifteen when she won her first championship.
sentences.cn: 她拿到第一个冠军的时候才15岁。

sentences.c: I hurt my foot and can barely walk.
sentences.cn: 我的脚受伤了，几乎没法走路。

sentences.c: The price of oil is usually given per barrel.
sentences.cn: 油价通常按桶计算。

sentences.c: The barren soil of the Rocky Mountains provides few nutrients to the grasses growing there.
sentences.cn: 落基山贫瘠的土壤几乎无法给生长在那里的草提供足够的营养。

etymology.d: barr（= bare 光光的）+ en → 一无所有的 → 贫瘠的

sentences.c: The toy department is in the basement of the store.
sentences.cn: 玩具部设在商场的地下楼层。

trans.cn: （面包等）一炉，一批；（人或物）一批

sentences.c: Our second batch of bread was better than the first.
sentences.cn: 我们第二批的面包要比第一批的好。

sentences.c: The submarine disappeared beneath the waves.
sentences.cn: 潜水艇消失在浪涛之下。

sentences.c: Mary betrayed Bill by having a love affair.
sentences.cn: 玛丽背叛了比尔，和别人谈恋爱了。

sentences.c: Although she is nervous on stage, her actions do not betray her feelings.
sentences.cn: 虽然她在舞台上很紧张，但是并没有在肢体动作中表现出来。

sentences.c: The police are bewildered by the mystery of the murder.
sentences.cn: 这起神秘的凶杀案让警察感到很困惑。

sentences.c: A committee has been established to address the problem of racial and sexual bias within the industry.
sentences.cn: 已成立了一个委员会以解决行业内的种族和性别歧视问题。

trans.cn: （有关某一专题或某一作者的）书目，参考书目

sentences.c: How many books were listed in this bibliography?
sentences.cn: 这个参考书目里列了多少本书？

etymology.d: biblio（圣经，书）+ graphy → 书目

sentences.c: The reading of a biography gives a knowledge of people and events that cannot always be obtained from history books.
sentences.cn: 阅读传记能让人获得关于人物和事件的知识，而这些知识通常在历史书上是学不到的。

trans.cn: （指态度、容貌、款式等）奇异的，古怪的

sentences.c: The frost made bizarre figures on the windowpanes.
sentences.cn: 霜冻在窗户玻璃上形成了奇异的图案。

sentences.c: A fire was blazing in the fireplace.
sentences.cn: 壁炉中的火正在燃烧。

sentences.c: We could see the blaze of the campfire across the beach.

sentences.cn: 那起交通事故的肇事司机贿赂警察，好让警察放她走。

sentences.cn: 一个赌徒收买了其中的一个拳击手，让他输掉比赛。

sentences.cn: 请别把我的杯子倒满，因为我总会往咖啡里放很多奶油。

sentences.cn: 酪乳是制作黄油时产生的副产品。

sentences.cn: 这份10页的总结是一份100页报告的浓缩。

sentences.c: The President of Harvard University conferred a doctorate on the distinguished politician.
sentences.cn: 哈佛大学校长授予这位著名的政治家博士头衔。

sentences.c: One should confer with one's elders before making a big decision.
sentences.cn: 在做重大决定之前应该和前辈商量一下。

sentences.c: A conference was called to discuss getting a playground for the school.
sentences.cn: 为了讨论给学校建操场的事情召开了一次会议。

sentences.c: Only highly trusted employees could read the confidential report.
sentences.cn: 只有非常可信的雇员才能看这份机密报告。

etymology.d: con + fid（相信）+ ent + ial → 被相信才能知道的 → 机密的

sentences.c: Geographers study the configuration of the surface of the earth.
sentences.cn: 地理学家研究地球表面的地形构造。

etymology.d: con + figur(e)（形状）+ aion → 全部形状 → 轮廓

sentences.c: Every member must conform to the rules of our club.
sentences.cn: 每位会员必须遵守我们社团的规章制度。

sentences.c: I sent a card of congratulation to the newly married couple.
sentences.cn: 我给这对新婚夫妇发了一张祝福贺卡。

sentences.c: Conscientious work is careful and exact.
sentences.cn: 认真尽责的工作意味着细心和准确。

etymology.d: con（全部）+ sci（知道）+ ent + ious → 知道、关心多的 → 有责任心的

sentences.c: He was reelected for four consecutive terms.
sentences.cn: 他又连着当选了四次。

etymology.d: con + secu（跟随）+ tive → 一个接一个地跟随 → 连续的

sentences.c: The council reached a consensus on the date of the election.
sentences.cn: 委员会就选举日期达成一致。

etymology.d: con + sensus（感觉，认识）→ 共识 → 意见一致

sentences.c: You need the principal's consent to leave campus.
sentences.cn: 你得到校长的同意才可以离开学校。

trans.cn: 作为结果的，随之发生的

sentences.c: His long illness and consequent absence put him far behind in his work.
sentences.cn: 他久病请假，使他的工作落后了许多。

sentences.c: An experienced backpacker can give you many suggestions for conserving energy on a long, tough hike.
sentences.cn: 一位经验丰富的背包客可以在长途跋涉方面给你很多保存体力的建议。

sentences.c: The political party consolidated its power by winning many state elections.
sentences.cn: 该政党赢得很多州的选票，巩固了势力。

sentences.c: If we consolidate our efforts, we'll get the job done much faster.
sentences.cn: 如果我们共同努力，就会更早地完成这项工作。

etymology.d: con + solid（结实）+ ate → 巩固

trans.cn: 显著的；显眼的，引人注目的

sentences.c: With everyone else dressed in colorful party clothes, my old blue jeans were painfully conspicuous.
sentences.cn: 其他人都穿了艳丽的礼服，和他们在一起，我旧旧的蓝色牛仔裤特别扎眼。

etymology.d: con（大家）+ spic（看）+ uous → 大家都看见的 → 显眼的

sentences.c: Hydrogen and oxygen are the constituents of water.
sentences.cn: 氢和氧是水的成分。

sentences.c: As a senator he was excellent—always talking to his constituents and listening to their problems.
sentences.cn: 这位参议员很优秀，他总是耐心与选民交谈并认真聆听他们的问题。

etymology.d: con + stit（= stat 站）+ uent → 站在一起的东西 → 成分

sentences.c: Bill tried to constrain a cough during the lecture.
sentences.cn: 上课时比尔尽量忍着不咳嗽。

sentences.c: Eye witness reports constructed a detailed description of the man.
sentences.cn: 目击者的报告构成了有关此人相貌的一幅详图。

sentences.c: At our Thanksgiving dinner, we consumed an entire turkey.
sentences.cn: 感恩节晚餐我们吃了一整只火鸡。

sentences.c: The wound was contaminated by bacteria.
sentences.cn: 伤口受到了细菌感染。

trans.cn: 注视；沉思，（对…做）周密考虑

sentences.c: Please contemplate my request before answering.
sentences.cn: 答复之前请认真考虑下我的请求。

etymology.d: con + templ（思考，观察）+ ate → 全心思考 → 深思

sentences.c: I have great contempt for people who hurt others.
sentences.cn: 我特别鄙视伤害别人的人。

sentences.c: Two chimpanzees contended for one banana.
sentences.cn: 两只黑猩猩为争一根香蕉打了起来。

trans.cn: （时间、空间上的）连续性，连贯性

sentences.c: The continuity of her talk was broken when the telephone rang.
sentences.cn: 电话铃声打断了她的讲话。

trans.cn: 同…矛盾，同…抵触；提出反对意见

sentences.c: His mean actions contradicted his fine words.
sentences.cn: 他的卑劣行径与甜言蜜语互相矛盾。

sentences.c: Contrary to the advertisement, this cleanser does not remove tough stains.
sentences.cn: 与广告宣传的效果不同，这种清洁剂并不能去除顽固污渍。

sentences.c: He contrived an illness to miss a day of school.
sentences.cn: 他装病请假不去学校。

etymology.d: con + tri（反）+ ve（= vene 走）→（和普通人）反着走 → 设计（新东西）

trans.cn: 引起（或可能引起）争论的

sentences.c: The controversial bill was passed by a narrow vote.
sentences.cn: 在投票中，这项有争议的议案以微小的差异获得通过。

etymology.d: contro（反）+ vers（转）+ ial → 反转的 →（可能）引起争论的

sentences.c: At first, the two candidates disagreed on every issue, but as the campaign went on, their opinions seemed to converge.
sentences.cn: 起初，两位候选人在每个议题上意见都不同，但随着竞选的持续，他们的观点似乎越来越趋于一致。

sentences.c: She was busy but she was still able to cope with the extra work.
sentences.cn: 她很忙，但仍然可以应付额外的工作。

sentences.c: He was not very cordial to his girlfriend's former boyfriend.
sentences.cn: 他对他女朋友的前男友不大友好。

sentences.c: Janet worked for the Peace Corps for two years in North America.
sentences.cn: 珍妮特在北美洲的美国和平队工作了两年。

trans.cn: 使相互关联；使相互影响

sentences.c: Increasing cancer rates appear to correlate with rising levels of pollution.
sentences.cn: 癌症发病率的攀升似乎和环境污染日益严重相关。

sentences.c: Jane saved all of her grandmother's correspondence for years.
sentences.cn: 简保存了多年来祖母的所有信件。

sentences.c: Your account of the accident has little correspondence with the story the other driver told.
sentences.cn: 你对故事的描述与另一位司机的讲述几乎完全不同。

etymology.d: cor（共同）+ respond（回答）+ ence → 两人互相回答 → 通信

sentences.c: Acid will corrode certain types of metal.
sentences.cn: 酸性物质会腐蚀某些金属。

trans.cn: 堕落的；不诚实的；贪污受贿的

sentences.c: Bad companions may corrupt a person.
sentences.cn: 品行不端的伙伴可能会毁掉一个人。

sentences.c: The corrupt police officer took bribes.
sentences.cn: 这个腐败的警官接受了贿赂。

etymology.d: cor + rupt（断）→ 全断了的 →（使）堕落

sentences.c: Some people believe that what happens in their lives is influenced by cosmic forces.
sentences.cn: 有些人认为他们生命中所发生的事是受到了宇宙力量的影响。

sentences.c: Janet paid a costly salary to hire an American teacher to help her improve her English.
sentences.cn: 珍妮特高薪聘请了一位美国老师来帮她提高英语水平。

etymology.d: cost（费用，代价）+ ly → 费用高的 → 昂贵的

sentences.c: The actors in the play had beautiful costumes.
sentences.cn: 剧中的演员们穿着好看的服装。

sentences.c: A couch refers to a long seat, usually upholstered and having a back and arms.
sentences.cn: 长沙发都有长长的座位，通常装软垫，并且有靠背和扶手。

sentences.c: His thoughts were couched in beautiful language.
sentences.cn: 他用优美的语言表达了自己的想法。

sentences.c: She's my counterpart in our New York office.
sentences.cn: 她在我们纽约办事处的职位和我的职位相当。

sentences.c: It is a sign of courtesy to give one's seat to another person on a crowded bus.
sentences.cn: 在拥挤的公共汽车上给人让座是一种有礼貌的表现。

sentences.c: Mr. Black is a coward; he is easily scared by others' threats.
sentences.cn: 布莱克先生是个胆小鬼；他很容易被别人的威胁吓到。

trans.cn: （船上、飞机上的）全体工作人员；同事们

sentences.c: The aircraft has a crew of seven.
sentences.cn: 飞机上有七名机务人员。

sentences.c: India has been crippled by foreign debts.
sentences.cn: 印度由于外债累累而陷入困境。

sentences.c: Dry toast and fresh celery are crisp.
sentences.cn: 干面包和新鲜芹菜都是脆的。

sentences.c: They think that wealth is the only criterion of success.
sentences.cn: 他们认为财富是判断是否成功的唯一标准。

etymology.d: crit（判断，分辨）+ erion → 标准

sentences.c: He won the amateur boxing crown in his latest bout.
sentences.cn: 他在最近的一场拳击比赛中赢得了非职业选手冠军。

sentences.c: After the death of the old king, the princess was crowned in London.
sentences.cn: 老国王死后，女王在伦敦加冕。

sentences.c: His former wife accused him of beating, verbal abuse and other cruelties.
sentences.cn: 他的前妻控告他的殴打、谩骂等残忍行为。

trans.cn: 提示，暗示（尤指戏剧等演出中对演员起暗示作用的道白或动作）

sentences.c: The actor entered the stage right on cue.
sentences.cn: 就在这个时候，男演员走上了舞台。

sentences.c: The wedding culminated with a big dance.
sentences.cn: 婚礼的气氛随着大型舞蹈达到了高潮。

etymology.d: culmin（顶点，高峰）+ ate → 达到高潮

sentences.c: The cumulative effects of many illnesses made the patient weak.
sentences.cn: 诸病缠身，病情日益恶化，病人变得很虚弱。

sentences.c: The cunning businesswoman sold the house for double its value.
sentences.cn: 这个精明的女商人以实际价值两倍的价钱卖掉了这座房子。

sentences.c: Park the car close to the curb.
sentences.cn: 靠路边停车。

sentences.c: I went on a diet and curbed my appetite for food and drink.
sentences.cn: 我节食，并且控制自己的食欲。

sentences.c: Little kids are usually very curious and ask a lot of questions.
sentences.cn: 小孩通常都很好奇，问很多问题。

sentences.c: They are trying to widen the college curricula to meet the students' needs.
sentences.cn: 他们正在试着拓宽大学课程范围，以满足学生们的需求。

sentences.c: Ten o'clock is Janet's customary bedtime.
sentences.cn: 珍妮特通常十点上床睡觉。

etymology.d: custom（习惯）+ ary → 习惯上的

sentences.c: Bob's too cynical to believe in psychic phenomenon, while Janet believes in it completely.
sentences.cn: 鲍勃不相信存在什么灵异现象，但珍妮特却深信不疑。

etymology.d: cyn（狗）+ ic + al → 像狗一样活着的 → 犬儒主义的 → 愤世嫉俗的

sentences.c: The critics damned the new book and pointed out a lot of mistakes in it.
sentences.cn: 评论家们对这本新书提出了指责，并指出了书中的很多处错误。

sentences.c: Metals rust most rapidly in damp regions.
sentences.cn: 金属在潮湿的地方生锈最快。

etymology.d: dam（水坝）+ p → 水坝是潮湿的 → 潮湿的

sentences.c: The laser system temporarily blinds enemy pilots with rays of dazzling light.
sentences.cn: 激光系统利用强光让敌机飞行员暂时看不见东西。

sentences.c: If I didn't turn in the report by the deadline, I would be fired.
sentences.cn: 如果我到最后期限还没有把报告交上去，我会被解雇的。

sentences.c: This is one of nature's deadliest poisons.
sentences.cn: 这是自然界最致命的毒药之一。

etymology.d: dead（死）+ ly → 致死的

sentences.c: The metric system is a decimal system.
sentences.cn: 公制是十进制。

sentences.c: The course will help students develop mathematical skills including the use of decimals, fractions, percentages and simple statistics.
sentences.cn: 这项课程会帮助学生提高数学能力，包括小数、分数、百分比和简单的统计学的应用能力。

etymology.d: decim（十分之一）+ al → 小数

sentences.c: The team won by 20 points, which was a decisive victory.
sentences.cn: 这个队以20分的优势赢得了决定性的胜利。

sentences.c: The book was dedicated to the author's husband.
sentences.cn: 此书谨献给作者的丈夫。

sentences.c: Doctors prescribe the medicines they deem necessary to cure their patients.
sentences.cn: 医生们给病人开药，这些药是医生认为对治疗有必要的。

sentences.c: In Africa, most children live a poor life because of economic deficiency in their families.
sentences.cn: 在非洲，大多数的儿童因为家庭贫穷过着困苦的生活。

sentences.c: The government tried to avoid a budget deficit and spend strictly according to the plan.
sentences.cn: 政府为避免财政赤字，根据计划严格控制消费。

sentences.c: The child defied his baby-sitter by refusing to go to bed.
sentences.cn: 这个小孩不听保姆的话，就是不上床睡觉。

sentences.c: Her health degenerated because of the disease.
sentences.cn: 因为这个病，她的身体越来越差。

sentences.c: Janet would not degrade herself by begging for help from the person who insulted her.
sentences.cn: 珍妮特是不会低头向那些侮辱她的人乞求帮助的。

etymology.d: de + grade（等级）→ 使降级

trans.cn: ①（尤指坏事）故意的，早有准备的
② 审慎的，深思熟虑的

sentences.c: Their excuse was a deliberate lie, but nobody detected it.
sentences.cn: 他们的理由是个精心编造的谎言，但没人发觉。

sentences.c: He is very deliberate in everything he says and does, so he rarely hurts others.
sentences.cn: 他说话办事总是考虑周全，所以他很少伤害到其他人。

etymology.d: de + liber（自由）+ ate → 非自由的 → 不是随随便便的 → 审慎的

sentences.c: Winning the award delighted him.
sentences.cn: 他得了奖，这令他非常高兴。

sentences.c: Galileo was forced to make a public denial of his belief that the Earth goes around the Sun.
sentences.cn: 伽利略相信地球是绕着太阳转的，他被迫公开否认了这个观点。

sentences.c: His levity at such a serious moment denoted a lack of feeling.
sentences.cn: 在这么严肃的时刻，他轻浮的举动显示出他的无情。

sentences.c: The reform candidate denounced the corrupt city officers for having betrayed the public's trust.
sentences.cn: 改革派候选人公开指责腐败的城市官员背叛了民众的信任。

etymology.d: de + nounce（报告）→ 坏报告 → 指责

sentences.c: A dentist fills cavities in teeth, cleans, straightens or extracts them, and supplies artificial teeth.
sentences.cn: 牙医的工作是补牙、洗牙、矫正牙、拔牙，还有装义齿。

sentences.c: The airplane's departure for New York was delayed by a blizzard.
sentences.cn: 飞往纽约的航班因暴风雪推迟起飞时间。

sentences.c: Her paintings depict the lives of ordinary people in the last century.
sentences.cn: 她的油画描绘了上个世纪老百姓的生活。

etymology.d: de（强调作用）+ pict（画）→ 刻画 → 描述

sentences.c: He was deprived of his sight by the accident.
sentences.cn: 那次事故使他丧失了视力。

sentences.c: She is a descendant of the 18th-century immigrants.
sentences.cn: 她是18世纪移民者的后裔。

etymology.d: descend（传下）+ ant → 子孙

sentences.c: The gull made a quick descent and plucked a fish from the water.
sentences.cn: 海鸥突然俯冲，把一条鱼从水里叼了出来。

sentences.c: He is of Arabic descent.
sentences.cn: 他有阿拉伯血统。

sentences.c: The teacher has designated me as the group leader.
sentences.cn: 老师指定我为小组组长。

sentences.c: I've always despised people who say nasty things about others.
sentences.cn: 我一向看不起那些说别人坏话的人。

sentences.c: We had apple pie and coffee for dessert.
sentences.cn: 我们的餐后甜点有苹果派和咖啡。

sentences.c: Whether as statesman, scientist or philosopher, Benjamin Franklin was destined to gain lasting honor throughout much of the world.
sentences.cn: 无论是作为政治家、科学家还是哲学家，本杰明·富兰克林注定声名远扬，留芳百世。

etymology.d: de（向下）+ stin（站，立）+ e → 在下面站好的 → 命中注定

sentences.c: The war brought death and destruction to the city.
sentences.cn: 战争给这座城市带来了死亡和毁灭。

sentences.c: The house is being battered by a destructive hurricane.
sentences.cn: 房子被一场毁灭性的龙卷风损毁。

etymology.d: de + struct（结构，建造）+ ive → 反建设性的 → 破坏的

sentences.c: She had trouble detaching the gum from her shoe.
sentences.cn: 她弄不掉鞋上的口香糖。

sentences.c: One squad of soldiers was detached to guard the road.
sentences.cn: 一班士兵被派去防守公路。

etymology.d: de + tach（接触）→ 不接触 → 分开

sentences.c: Her report was complete; it didn't leave out a single detail.
sentences.cn: 她完成了报告，没有遗漏任何细节。

sentences.c: Our son detailed all the things he had done on his trip to Europe to us.
sentences.cn: 我们的儿子把他在去欧洲的旅途中所做的事详细地跟我们说明了。

sentences.c: Sherlock Holmes is the best known of all fictional detectives.
sentences.cn: 夏洛克·福尔摩斯是所有虚构故事中最有名的侦探。

sentences.c: Your health will deteriorate if you work so hard.
sentences.cn: 如果你这么拼命工作，你的健康将会恶化。

sentences.c: His account of the accident seems to deviate from the facts.
sentences.cn: 他对事故的陈述似乎偏离了事实。

sentences.c: The doctor diagnosed the disease as measles.
sentences.cn: 医生诊断这种疾病为麻疹。

sentences.c: The dictator seized control of the government and took complete power over the people of the country.
sentences.cn: 独裁者掌握了政权，剥夺了该国人民的一切权利。

sentences.c: Consideration for others differentiates a thoughtful person from a thoughtless person.
sentences.cn: 能否为别人考虑是体贴的人与不体贴的人之间的区别。

sentences.c: Schools and libraries diffuse knowledge.
sentences.cn: 学校和图书馆都传播知识。

sentences.c: The technology is diffused and adopted by other countries.
sentences.cn: 这项技术在其他国家得到传播和使用。

sentences.c: The king should manifest the dignity matching his status.
sentences.cn: 国王应该展现出与自己地位相符的尊严。

sentences.c: Janet faced the dilemma of whether to go abroad to study or earn a lot of money in China by taking advantage of her current good opportunity.
sentences.cn: 珍妮特面临进退两难的境地，她不知道是该出国深造，还是该利用这次机会在中国挣更多的钱。

etymology.d: di（两个，双）+ lemma（争论）→ 两种争论 → 进退两难

sentences.c: He's not especially clever, but he's a diligent worker and should do well in the examinations.
sentences.cn: 他不是特别聪明，但他是一个勤奋的工人，应该会在这次考核中取得好成绩。

etymology.d: di（双）+ lig（选出）+ ent → 双倍选出（时间）的 → 勤勉的

sentences.c: She preferred her coffee diluted with milk.
sentences.cn: 她更喜欢用牛奶稀释咖啡。

sentences.c: The excessive heat diminished as the sun went down.
sentences.cn: 随着太阳下山，余热也慢慢减退。

sentences.c: Let's dine out tonight.
sentences.cn: 我们今天晚上去外面吃饭吧。

sentences.c: Companies hiring today require a high school diploma as a bare minimum.
sentences.cn: 现在公司招聘要求的最低学历是中学。

sentences.c: A telephone book is a directory of people who have telephones.
sentences.cn: 电话本是一本电话持有者的目录。

sentences.c: She had dirt on her shoes when she came in from the muddy street.
sentences.cn: 她从泥泞的街道上走进来的时候，鞋子上都是泥。

sentences.c: Traffic accidents disable thousands of children a year.
sentences.cn: 交通事故每年造成数以千计的儿童残疾。

etymology.d: dis（不，消失）+ able（能够的）→ 使不能 → 使残疾

sentences.c: The month-long period of rain was a disaster for the farmer.
sentences.cn: 持续一个月之久的降雨对农民来说是一场灾难。

sentences.c: It was too hard to discern the location of the hidden key.
sentences.cn: 找到藏起来的钥匙实在是太难了。

etymology.d: dis + cern（= sift 筛）→ 筛出来 → 看出

sentences.c: I can't disclose the source of my information, because I promised not to tell.
sentences.cn: 我不能公开我的信息来源，因为我答应过不会说出去。

sentences.c: Nothing will discourage him from his determination to take part in the London Marathon.
sentences.cn: 没有什么能动摇他参加伦敦马拉松赛的决心。

sentences.c: There was a discrepancy in the two witnesses' reports of the accident.
sentences.cn: 在这两份目击者关于交通事故的报告中有矛盾之处。

trans.cn: 独立的；不连续的，离散的

sentences.c: These computers operate in a series of discrete steps.
sentences.cn: 这些计算机以一连串独立的步骤运行。

sentences.c: The twins' appearance is alike and I cannot discriminate one from another.
sentences.cn: 这对双胞胎长得很像，我无法分辨出他们谁是谁。

sentences.c: It is wrong to discriminate against people because of their race, religion, nationality or sex.
sentences.cn: 因为种族、宗教、国籍或者是性别的原因而去歧视他人是错误的。

sentences.c: At Halloween I disguised myself as a ghost.
sentences.cn: 过万圣节时，我把自己伪装成鬼怪。

etymology.d: dis（不同）+ guise（姿态，伪装）→ 掩盖

sentences.c: The robbers brought dishonor to their families.
sentences.cn: 强盗使他们的家庭蒙受耻辱。

sentences.c: She dishonored her family by marrying a thief.
sentences.cn: 她嫁给了一个小偷，使她的家庭蒙受耻辱。

sentences.c: They were filled with dismay when they saw the rattlesnake.
sentences.cn: 他们看见响尾蛇之后惊慌失措。

sentences.c: Two loads of woolen cloth were dispatched to the factory on December 12th.
sentences.cn: 两车呢绒在12月12日被送到了工厂。

sentences.c: The correspondent in Paris rushed news dispatches to her newspaper in New York.
sentences.cn: 在巴黎的通讯员紧急将新闻发送给了她在纽约的报社。

sentences.c: The police fired tear gas into the crowd to disperse the protesters.
sentences.cn: 警察喷射催泪瓦斯驱赶抗议的人群。

sentences.c: The building of a new dam will displace thousands of people who live in this area.
sentences.cn: 建造一座新的水坝将使数以千计生活在这里的人转移。

sentences.c: Locals are objecting to the park being used as a disposal site for household waste.
sentences.cn: 当地人反对将公园用作家庭垃圾的处理场。

sentences.c: His cheerful and kind disposition made him popular.
sentences.cn: 他开朗和善的性格让他很受欢迎。

sentences.c: Disregarding the cold weather, we played outside all day.
sentences.cn: 我们全然不顾寒冷的天气，在外面玩了一整天。

sentences.c: A heavy snowfall had disrupted the city's transportation system.
sentences.cn: 一场暴雪让这座城市的交通陷入瘫痪。

sentences.c: Darkness soon dissipated as morning dawned.
sentences.cn: 破晓时，黑夜被一驱而散。

sentences.c: A substance is distilled in order to purify it, to separate its liquid parts from its solid parts, or to break it down into separate substances.
sentences.cn: 蒸馏是为了净化物质，或者将液体从固体中分离出来，又或者是将它分解成分离的物质。

sentences.c: His face was distorted in agony.
sentences.cn: 他的表情因为痛苦而扭曲。

sentences.c: The noise of traffic outside the classroom may distract the students' focus of attention.
sentences.cn: 教室外面的交通噪音可能会分散学生们的注意力。

sentences.c: Wall Street is in the financial district of New York.
sentences.cn: 华尔街位于纽约的金融区。

sentences.c: The police were called to quieten the disturbance at the street corner.
sentences.cn: 警察被派去平息街角的骚乱。

sentences.c: A magician's talk creates a diversion of attention so that people do not see how the tricks are done.
sentences.cn: 魔术师通过说话来转移观众的注意力，这样观众们就无法看清楚魔术是怎么变的了。

sentences.c: After studying for several hours, he needed a diversion from work.
sentences.cn: 在学习了几个小时之后，他需要停下来放松一会儿。

sentences.c: Traffic will be diverted through the side streets while the main road is resurfaced.
sentences.cn: 交通将从支路改道，同时主路会重新铺设。

sentences.c: The Bible describes the creation of the world as a divine act.《
sentences.cn: 圣经》将创造世界描述成神的行为。

etymology.d: div（神）+ ine → 神圣的；参考：divinity（神性）

sentences.c: They divorced after ten years of marriage.
sentences.cn: 在经历了十年的婚姻之后，他们离婚了。

sentences.c: Economics cannot be divorced from politics.
sentences.cn: 经济无法与政治脱离关系。

sentences.c: When you spin round and round and stop suddenly, you feel dizzy.
sentences.cn: 当你转了一圈又一圈然后突然停下来的时候，你会感到眩晕。

etymology.d: dizz（转）+ y → 转得多的 → 眩晕的

sentences.c: Ships load and unload beside a dock.
sentences.cn: 轮船在码头旁装卸货物。

sentences.c: The cult members obeyed their leader's doctrines.
sentences.cn: 信徒遵循他们教会首领的教义。

sentences.c: This valley is the domain of our people. Nobody can enter it without our permission.
sentences.cn: 这座山谷是我们的地盘，任何人未经允许不得入内。

etymology.d: dom（屋，家）+ ain → 自家的领土 → 领域

sentences.c: The new baseball stadium is covered by a dome.
sentences.cn: 新的棒球场由穹形顶覆盖。

sentences.c: Susan asked her lawyer to donate all her possessions to charity after her death.
sentences.cn: 苏珊要求她的律师在她去世后，把她所有的财产捐给慈善机构。

sentences.c: The prisoner sentenced to death was doomed to be killed.
sentences.cn: 被判死刑的犯人注定会被处死。

sentences.c: The woodcutter dragged the heavy fallen tree to the roadside.
sentences.cn: 樵夫将倒下的、沉重的树拖到了路边。

sentences.c: The drainage of swamps improved the land.
sentences.cn: 把沼泽的水排掉提高了土地质量。

etymology.d: 来自 drain（排水）

sentences.c: Shaving off his beard created a dramatic change in his appearance.
sentences.cn: 他把胡子刮掉之后，相貌发生了戏剧性的改变。

sentences.c: NATO threatened more drastic action if its terms were not met.
sentences.cn: 北约威胁如果不履行条款，将采取更为激烈的措施。

sentences.c: The drawback to working the morning shift is having to get up early.
sentences.cn: 上早班的弊端就是你必须早早起床。

sentences.c: The prospect of meeting her boyfriend's relatives filled Janet with dread.
sentences.cn: 珍妮特一想到要与她男朋友的亲属见面，就感到十分恐惧。

sentences.c: Bob drills an opening in the door for the lock.
sentences.cn: 鲍勃为了给门装锁，把门钻了一个开口。

sentences.c: He drilled the children in what they should say.
sentences.cn: 他训练孩子们学会该说什么话。

sentences.c: The water level in the reservoirs was low because of the long drought.
sentences.cn: 由于长期干旱，水库里的水位变得很低。

sentences.c: The driving school's cars had dual controls; one set for the learner and one for the teacher.
sentences.cn: 驾校的汽车有两套控制系统，一套为学员而设，一套为教练而设。

trans.cn: 可疑的；怀疑的，不确定的

sentences.c: The senator was dubious about his chances of reelection because of the scandal.
sentences.cn: 由于丑闻，参议员对他改选获胜的机会持怀疑态度。

etymology.d: dub（二，双）+ ious → 在两种状态间游移的 → 不肯定的 → 怀疑的

trans.cn: 两重的，两倍的；完全相同的

sentences.c: Duplicate the picture so that we may both have a copy of it.
sentences.cn: 把照片复制下来，这样我们俩都会留一份。

sentences.c: A human being has duplicate lungs but only one heart.
sentences.cn: 人有两片肺，但是只有一个心脏。

etymology.d: du + plic（重叠）+ ate → 使重叠 → 复制

sentences.c: The duration of the examination is three hours.
sentences.cn: 考试时间是三个小时。

sentences.c: Janet dwells in Harbin.
sentences.cn: 珍妮特住在哈尔滨。

sentences.c: My earnings for the job weren't as high as I expected.
sentences.cn: 这份工作的收入没有我期望的高。

sentences.c: The reporter writes with great ease, because he is good at writing and did a lot of research on this topic.
sentences.cn: 因为这位记者十分擅长写作，并且对这个选题做了很多研究，所以他写起来很轻松。

sentences.c: If you go to the palace in tennis shoes, they'll think you're rather eccentric.
sentences.cn: 如果你穿着网球鞋去王宫，他们会觉得你十分古怪。

etymology.d: ec（出）+ centr（中心）+ ic → 离开中心的 → 古怪的

sentences.c: There will be a lunar eclipse tonight.
sentences.cn: 今晚会有月食。

sentences.c: She is completely eclipsed by her sister, who is cleverer, prettier and more amusing.
sentences.cn: 她在她妹妹面前黯然失色。她的妹妹比她更聪明、更漂亮、更迷人。

sentences.c: The oil spill caused terrible damage to the fragile ecology of the coastline.
sentences.cn: 石油泄漏给脆弱的沿海生态环境造成了严重的破坏。

sentences.c: John is at the edge of death.
sentences.cn: 约翰处于死亡的边缘。

sentences.c: Laurels are valued for their aromatic oils and spices, edible fruits and timber.
sentences.cn: 月桂树的价值在于能提供芳香油、香料、可食用的果实以及木料。

etymology.d: ed（= eat 吃）+ ible → 可食用的

sentences.c: Sharing corporate stocks with employees can be an effective way to promote harmony, efficiency and equitability in the workplace.
sentences.cn: 让员工入股可以有效地提高职场的和谐、效率和公平的程度。

etymology.d: effect（效果）+ ive → 有效的

sentences.c: The hooligans were ejected from the restaurant.
sentences.cn: 小流氓被赶出了餐厅。

sentences.c: Ants eject formic acid when another insect tries to attack them.
sentences.cn: 当被其他昆虫攻击的时候，蚂蚁就会释放出蚁酸。

etymology.d: e + ject（推）→ 推出 → 逐出

sentences.c: Many hours elapsed while I slept.
sentences.cn: 我睡了好多个小时。

trans.cn: 过了中年的；近老年的；稍老的

sentences.c: The elderly woman lives with her grandson.
sentences.cn: 老妇人和她的孙子一起生活。

sentences.c: The marchers elevated the flag as they passed the president.
sentences.cn: 从总统身边走过的时候，游行者举起了旗帜。

sentences.c: The comedian's joke elicited laughter from the audience.
sentences.cn: 喜剧演员的笑话逗得观众哈哈大笑。

etymology.d: e（出）+ licit（引导）→ 引出

sentences.c: Only native-born citizens are eligible for the office of President.
sentences.cn: 只有本国公民才有资格当总统。

etymology.d: e + lig（选）+ ible → 选出来的 → 合格的

sentences.c: Only the elites attended the reception for the visiting queen.
sentences.cn: 只有社会精英们参加了女王访问招待会。

etymology.d: e + lite（= lig 选择）→ 选出来的 → 精英

trans.cn: 善于表达的，有口才的，雄辩的

sentences.c: Janet is an eloquent speaker and good at business negotiation.
sentences.cn: 珍妮特口才很好，擅长商业谈判。

etymology.d: e + loqu（说话）+ ent → 能说出来的 → 有口才的

sentences.c: The ship will leave soon and all passengers must embark in ten minutes.
sentences.cn: 船马上就要起航了，所有乘客务必在十分钟内登船。

sentences.c: After leaving college, Janet embarked upon a business career.
sentences.cn: 离开大学之后，珍妮特开始了商业生涯。

etymology.d: em（= in）+ bark（三桅船）→ 进到船里 →（使）上船（或飞机）

sentences.c: While traveling abroad we had to go to the Chinese embassy to resolve the emergency.
sentences.cn: 在境外旅行遇到紧急情况时，我们不得不去中国大使馆寻求帮助。

sentences.c: Small stones were embedded in the ice.
sentences.cn: 小石子嵌入了冰块里。

sentences.c: My grandmother embodies all the qualities of her generation.
sentences.cn: 我的祖母体现了她这一代人所具有的所有素质。

etymology.d: em + body（身体）→（思想）变成身体 → 使具体化

sentences.c: Her family emigrated to America in the 1850s.
sentences.cn: 在19世纪50年代，她们家移居到了美国。

sentences.c: An emission of smoke showed that there was a fire in the house.
sentences.cn: 有烟冒出来说明房子起火了。

etymology.d: 来自 emit（发出），e（出来）+ mit（送）→ 送出 → 发出

sentences.c: This theory needed to be backed up with solid empirical evidence.
sentences.cn: 这个理论需要可靠的实验来证明。

sentences.c: The coach encourages Jimmy to practice more often.
sentences.cn: 教练鼓励吉米再多加练习。

sentences.c: Drinking endangers one's liver.
sentences.cn: 饮酒对肝脏有害。

sentences.c: No matter how much he endeavors to move it, the stone remains in its place.
sentences.cn: 无论他怎么努力去搬，这块石头就是纹丝不动。

sentences.c: Graduates endowed their colleges with funds to support their operation.
sentences.cn: 毕业生们给母校捐款，支持学校运营。

sentences.c: Nature not only gave the Middle Atlantic region fine harbors, but also endowed it with a first-class system of inland waterways.
sentences.cn: 大自然不仅给予大西洋中部地区优良的海港，也赋予其一流的内陆水运系统。

sentences.c: Triathlon athletes must have incredible endurance.
sentences.cn: 铁人三项运动员必须具有惊人的耐力。

sentences.c: The energetic athlete runs 5 miles every day.
sentences.cn: 那位精力充沛的运动员每天跑5英里。

etymology.d: en + erg（能量，活力）+ y + etic → 精力充沛的

trans.cn: ① 强制服从或遵守；实施，执行
② 坚持（主张等）；加强（论点等）

sentences.c: The police enforce the law.
sentences.cn: 警察执行法律。

sentences.c: The speed limit is strongly enforced in this state.
sentences.cn: 这个国家严格执行限速规定。

sentences.c: The book enlightened me on the subject of medicine.
sentences.cn: 这本书在医药方面启发了我。

etymology.d: en + light（光）+ en →（使）进入有光的状态 → 启发

trans.cn: 加料于（食物）；使富足，使肥沃

sentences.c: I shall try to enrich my knowledge of the English language during this summer vacation.
sentences.cn: 我会在这个暑假扩充英语知识量。

etymology.d: en + rich（富足）→ 使富足

sentences.c: We must enroll in school on Friday.
sentences.cn: 我们必须在周五注册学籍。

sentences.c: Soldiers began firing at each other and a gun battle ensued.
sentences.cn: 士兵们开始互相射击，继而发生了一场枪战。

sentences.c: Your term paper is good enough to ensure a passing grade.
sentences.cn: 你的学期报告很优秀，一定能及格。

trans.cn: 使成为必要，使承担；使…发生

sentences.c: Owning an automobile entailed greater expense than we had expected.
sentences.cn: 拥有一辆汽车必须承担超过我们预期的开支。

etymology.d: en + tail（尾巴）→ 给…加上尾巴 → 使承担

sentences.c: The monkeys at the zoo provided the children with a lot of entertainment.
sentences.cn: 动物园里的猴子给孩子们带来了很多欢乐。

sentences.c: England, Scotland and Wales are all parts of Great Britain but each is also a separate entity.
sentences.cn: 英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士都属于英国，但是它们每一个都是独立体。

sentences.c: The intrepid entrepreneur transformed the town into a thriving shopping area.
sentences.cn: 那位强悍的企业家把这个城镇变成了繁华的商业中心。

sentences.c: The mountains were enveloped in sunlight.
sentences.cn: 群山笼罩在阳光里。

etymology.d: en（放进）+ velop（包）→ 把…包住

sentences.c: The architect looked at the plans and envisaged the finished house.
sentences.cn: 建筑师看着设计图，想像房子建成以后的样子。

sentences.c: There are epidemics of influenza nearly every winter.
sentences.cn: 几乎每个冬天都有流感。

sentences.c: He told me about an episode in the war.
sentences.cn: 他给我讲了战争时期的一个故事。

sentences.c: The glacial epoch lasted for thousands of years.
sentences.cn: 冰河期持续了数千年。

sentences.c: The acrobat in the circus maintained equilibrium on a tightrope.
sentences.cn: 杂技团的演员在拉紧的绳索上保持平衡。

sentences.c: The disintegration of the stone wall was caused by erosion.
sentences.cn: 石墙由于腐蚀作用而瓦解。

sentences.c: Janet held the erroneous belief that the more the goods cost the better they must be.
sentences.cn: 珍妮特错误地认为价格越贵，商品越好。

etymology.d: err（错误，谬误）+ oneous → 错误的

sentences.c: Steam erupted from the broken pipe.
sentences.cn: 蒸汽从破损的管道里喷发出来。

sentences.c: The Prime Minister's car has a police escort.
sentences.cn: 总理的车有警察护卫。

sentences.c: Being thoughtful of others is the essence of politeness.
sentences.cn: 为别人考虑是礼貌的本质。

sentences.c: Not only do the tides advance and retreat in their eternal rhythms, but the surface of the sea itself is never at rest.
sentences.cn: 不仅是潮涨潮落有其本身永恒的规律，而且海平面也从来都不是静止的。

etymology.d: etern（时间，岁月）+ al → 永恒的

sentences.c: Ethics is the branch of philosophy that deals with the values of life in a coherent, systematic and scientific manner.
sentences.cn: 伦理学是哲学的分支，其对生命价值的探讨具有连贯性、系统性以及科学性。

sentences.c: The city's population includes a wide range of different ethnic groups.
sentences.cn: 城市的人口包括许多不同的种族。

sentences.c: We eventually arrived home after a long and tiring journey.
sentences.cn: 在经历了漫长而劳累的旅行之后，我们终于到家了。

trans.cn: 永久的，永恒的；无止境的

sentences.c: We wished them everlasting happiness.
sentences.cn: 我们祝他们永远幸福。

etymology.d: ever + lasting（持久的）→ 在任何时候都持久的 → 永恒的

sentences.c: The volcano is still active, as evidenced by the recent eruption.
sentences.cn: 这座火山仍然活跃，最近的喷发就证明了这一点。

sentences.c: Is there any scientific evidence that a person's character is reflected in their handwriting?
sentences.cn: 有科学证据表明，笔迹能反映一个人的性格吗？

sentences.c: This fragrance evokes the memory of a cool summer evening.
sentences.cn: 这种芳香唤起了我对一个凉爽夏夜的回忆。

etymology.d: e + voke（喊）→ 喊出来 → 唤起

sentences.c: Everyone passed the math test, with the exception of Tom.
sentences.cn: 除了汤姆之外，所有人都通过了数学考试。

sentences.c: The exceptional tennis player won the championship.
sentences.cn: 这个杰出的网球选手赢得了冠军。

etymology.d: ex（出）+ cept（拿）+ ion + al → 异常的；杰出的

sentences.c: You must curb your excessive spending, or you will become penniless.
sentences.cn: 你必须控制你的过度消费，否则你会变得身无分文。

etymology.d: ex + cess（走）+ ive → 走出去的 → 过分的

sentences.c: A patent gives inventors exclusive rights to their inventions for a fixed period of time.
sentences.cn: 专利赋予发明人在特定的时期内对该项发明的独占权。

etymology.d: ex + clus（关闭）+ ive → 关出去的 → 排外的

sentences.c: The committee is planning carefully for the execution of the project.
sentences.cn: 委员会仔细地为执行该项计划而进行规划。

sentences.c: This building exemplifies the architect's dedication and hard work.
sentences.cn: 这座建筑是建筑师无私奉献和辛苦工作的例证。

sentences.c: His lame leg exempted him from military service.
sentences.cn: 他因为瘸腿而被免除兵役。

etymology.d: ex + empt（拿，买）→ 拿出去 → 使免除

sentences.c: The deposed leaders were exiled to a neighboring country.
sentences.cn: 这几位被罢免的首领被流放到邻国。

etymology.d: ex（出）+ il（无目的地游荡）+ e → 出去无目的地游荡 → 放逐

sentences.c: We saw many exotic plants at the flower show; some of them were seen for the first time by the local people.
sentences.cn: 我们在花展上看到了很多外来植物，有些是本地人第一次看到的。

etymology.d: exo（外面）+ tic → 外来的

sentences.c: The explorers started on a year-long expedition down the Nile.
sentences.cn: 探险家们沿尼罗河而下，开始了为期一年的探险。

sentences.cn: 当我们呼气的时候，肺将空气排出体外。

sentences.c: He expended thought, work and money on this big project.
sentences.cn: 这个重要工程使他费尽心思、精力和金钱。

sentences.c: Because of his expertise in analysis, John was hired as a consultant.
sentences.cn: 由于约翰有分析的专门技术，他被聘为顾问。

sentences.c: My driver's license will expire next month and I have to renew it.
sentences.cn: 我的驾照下个月就要到期了，我必须更新。

sentences.cn: 空气从肺部排出来。

sentences.cn: 你的评论很清楚，没人会误解。

sentences.cn: 展品来自世界各国的展览称为博览会。

sentences.c: I've just bought an exquisite piece of china.
sentences.cn: 我刚买了一件精美的瓷器。

sentences.c: The handle isn't long enough; I need an extension.
sentences.cn: 手柄不够长，我需要延长它。

sentences.cn: 报纸报道了火灾造成的重大损失。

trans.cn: （动物）灭绝的；（火山）不再活跃的，熄灭的

sentences.c: Dinosaurs may have become extinct when a meteor struck Earth.
sentences.cn: 恐龙可能在陨石撞击地球的时候灭绝了。

etymology.d: ex（出）+ tinct（促使）→ 促使失去的 → 灭绝的

sentences.c: Water extinguished the fire.
sentences.cn: 水浇灭了火。

etymology.d: ex（出去）+ (s)tingu（压制，破坏）+ ish → 消灭，压制

sentences.c: Vanilla extract is a common ingredient in candies.
sentences.cn: 香草提取物是糖果的常用配料。

sentences.c: The doctor extracted the snake's poison from the bite.
sentences.cn: 医生把蛇毒从蛇咬的伤口处吸了出来。

sentences.c: His extravagant buying habits will have to stop.
sentences.cn: 他花钱大手大脚的习惯得改掉。

etymology.d: extra + vag（走）+ ant → 走得过分的 → 奢侈的

sentences.c: My favorite fable is the one about the tortoise and the hare.
sentences.cn: 我最喜欢的一个寓言是关于乌龟和兔子的。

sentences.c: Automobiles are fabricated from parts made in different factories.
sentences.cn: 汽车由不同工厂生产出来的配件组装而成。

sentences.c: The clerk fabricated an excuse to avoid questioning.
sentences.cn: 这个职员编造了一个理由，以免被质询。

etymology.d: fabric（构造）+ ate → 构造出来 → 伪造

sentences.c: The problem that we face now has many legal and financial facets.
sentences.cn: 我们现在面临的问题有很多法律和金融方面的问题。

sentences.c: Modern technology has facilitated the production process.
sentences.cn: 现代科技促进了生产力的发展。

sentences.c: Several senior workers were given awards for long and faithful service.
sentences.cn: 几位高级工人因为长期、忠诚的奉献而获得表彰。

sentences.c: The antique collector must be able to distinguish real antiques from fakes.
sentences.cn: 古董收藏者一定要有鉴别古董真伪的能力。

sentences.c: Her ring is set with a fake diamond.
sentences.cn: 她的戒指上镶了一颗假钻石。

sentences.c: He told a fantastic story about being abducted by creatures from outer space.
sentences.cn: 他讲了一个他被外太空生物绑架的离奇故事。

etymology.d: 来自 fantasy（幻想，怪念头）

sentences.c: What is the plane fare from London to Los Angeles?
sentences.cn: 从伦敦飞往洛杉矶的机票价格是多少？

sentences.c: She fascinated the audience with tales of her adventures.
sentences.cn: 她的冒险故事令观众们很着迷。

trans.cn: 有过失的；有缺点的，不完美的

sentences.c: You should repair the faulty electrical machines because it's dangerous for people to touch them.
sentences.cn: 你应该修理好这些有问题的电机，因为要是有人碰到它会很危险。

trans.cn: 有利的；顺利的；赢得赞扬的

sentences.c: We ought to set sail soon, while the weather is still favorable.
sentences.cn: 我们应该趁着天气还不错的时候马上起航。

sentences.c: The queen held a feast in honor of her son's marriage.
sentences.cn: 女王设宴为儿子庆祝新婚。

sentences.c: Each member of the federation keeps control over its own affairs.
sentences.cn: 联盟中每个成员的事务由他们自己来控制。

sentences.c: The old man was too feeble to walk.
sentences.cn: 老人太虚弱了，连路都没法走了。

sentences.c: Janet received a lot of feedback on her ideas about baby-sitting.
sentences.cn: 珍妮特当保姆的想法得到了很多人的回应。

trans.cn: 奖学金；研究员基金；同伙关系

sentences.c: She's applied to various foundations for a research fellowship.
sentences.cn: 她向许多基金会提交了研究员基金申请。

trans.cn: 女性的；有女性气质的；阴性的

sentences.c: The shop was decorated in a feminine manner.
sentences.cn: 这个商店的装饰风格很女性化。

etymology.d: femin（= woman女人）+ ine → 女人的

sentences.c: Many farmers fertilize their farmland with chemicals.
sentences.cn: 很多农民给他们的农田施化肥。

sentences.c: The resources of our planet are finite.
sentences.cn: 我们地球上的资源是有限的。

etymology.d: fin（范围，结束）+ ite → 有范围的 → 有限（制）的

sentences.c: She clenched her fists because of the pain.
sentences.cn: 她因为疼痛而紧握双拳。

trans.cn: （房屋等的）固定装置；固定设备

sentences.cn: 房价包含房屋内的所有固定装置。

sentences.c: The general concentrated his attack on the left flank of the opposing army.
sentences.cn: 将军集中火力攻击敌军的左翼。

sentences.c: The caged bird flapped its wings in a vain attempt to fly away.
sentences.cn: 笼子里的鸟拍打着翅膀想飞走，但却徒劳无功。

trans.cn: 闪光，突然爆发或燃烧，闪耀

sentences.cn: 当她把汽油浇到火上的时候，火势突然增大了。

sentences.c: The candle flared in the darkness.
sentences.cn: 蜡烛的火焰在黑暗中闪耀。

sentences.c: He flattered her by saying she looked like a movie star.
sentences.cn: 他讨好她，说她长得像电影明星。

sentences.cn: 这件衬衫价钱不贵，因为有一个小瑕疵。

sentences.cn: 舰队由一组军舰组成，并接受统一指挥。

sentences.c: The robber made a fleet escape.
sentences.cn: 强盗飞快地逃走了。

sentences.c: In a rage the wife flung the cup out of the room.
sentences.cn: 妻子一怒之下把杯子从房间里扔了出去。

sentences.c: The citizens' opinion of the president fluctuated from week to week.
sentences.cn: 人民对总统的看法每周都有所不同。

etymology.d: fluct（= flu 流动）+ uate → 波动，起伏

sentences.c: After dinner, she flushed food scraps down the garbage disposal.
sentences.cn: 晚饭以后，她把剩饭倒到垃圾处理机里冲走。

sentences.c: He flushed with anger when I insulted him.
sentences.cn: 我羞辱了他，他的脸气得通红。

sentences.c: The flag fluttered in the breeze.
sentences.cn: 旗子在微风中飘扬。

sentences.c: I like to shake my soda to create a foam.
sentences.cn: 我喜欢摇晃苏打水来产生泡沫。

sentences.cn: 为了保鲜，糖果有时会被裹上一层箔纸。

sentences.c: His attempt to kill the leader was foiled by the guard.
sentences.cn: 他试图刺杀首领，被守卫阻止了。

sentences.c: He folded his arms in anticipation of a long wait at the doctor's office.
sentences.cn: 他把双臂抱在胸前，做好在医生的办公室里等很长时间的准备。

sentences.cn: 小猫在窗帘的皱褶处玩耍。

sentences.cn: 迷路的徒步旅行者的首要目的是平安到家。

sentences.c: We didn't take our bathing suits because we could foresee that the water would be too cold for us to swim.
sentences.cn: 我们没有带泳衣，因为我们预计水会很凉而不适合游泳。

etymology.d: fore（前面）+ see（看见）→ 提前看见 → 预见

sentences.c: Cancer is a formidable disease, killing millions of people every year.
sentences.cn: 癌症是一种可怕的疾病，每年夺去数百万人的生命。

sentences.cn: 战士们匆忙地建造了一座简易的木头堡垒。

sentences.cn: 来年珍妮特将会很忙，因为她需要重新找工作。

sentences.c: The phone-in program provides a forum for the public to express their views on different topics.
sentences.cn: 热线电话直播节目提供了一个平台，让公众针对不同话题表达自己的观点。

sentences.c: Fossils of ferns are found in coal.
sentences.cn: 煤炭里发现了蕨类植物的化石。

sentences.c: The leader fostered the growth of small-scale industries.
sentences.cn: 领导鼓励小型企业的发展。

sentences.cn: 他不觉得胳膊断了，但是X光片显示有轻微骨折。

sentences.c: The rock fractured under the tremendous pressure.
sentences.cn: 石头在受到重压之后裂了。

sentences.cn: 哈尔滨人喜欢冬天在冰冷刺骨的水里游泳。

sentences.cn: 那个曾经被他辱骂过的人给了他一个冷冰冰的问候。

sentences.cn: 宇宙飞船飞抵太阳系边缘。

sentences.cn: 刘易斯和克拉克率领一支勘查过美国边境的探险队。

sentences.cn: 她希望读夜校能进一步发展她的事业。

sentences.cn: 化学家把两种金属熔合，形成了新的合金。

sentences.cn: 我们生活在一个叫银河系的巨大星系中。

sentences.cn: 别拿你输不起的东西当赌注。

sentences.cn: 我早上忘记把垃圾拿出去扔到垃圾收集站了。

sentences.cn: 当那位徒步旅行者到达目的地时，她大口喘着气。

sentences.cn: 小孩盯着魔术师，想看看将会发生什么事。

sentences.cn: 他的心脏病是遗传的，他的父亲也有心脏病。

sentences.cn: 大象是一种庞大的动物。

sentences.cn: 汤姆瞟了一眼那只可怜的动物，随即离开了。

sentences.cn: 太阳镜能减少（射入眼睛的）强光。

sentences.cn: 一缕微光从监狱的窗户照射进来。

sentences.cn: 飞机引擎出故障之后，飞机靠滑翔下降并安全着陆。

sentences.cn: 从山顶往下看，我们能看见城市的灯光闪闪发亮。

sentences.cn: 一个魅力十足的模特赢得了选美比赛。

sentences.cn: 这位总统统治了这个国家八年。

sentences.cn: 她优雅的举止深受客人赞赏。

sentences.cn: 我十分感谢你给予我的帮助。

sentences.cn: 这个乞丐的生活充满了不幸。

sentences.cn: 我的父母听说窗户被打破时生气了。

sentences.cn: 花栗鼠做出的滑稽动作逗得她咧嘴大笑。

sentences.cn: 抬担架的人试着去挪动伤员时，伤员们发出了痛苦的呻吟。

sentences.c: Tom groped around in the dark in order to find the light switch.
sentences.cn: 汤姆在黑暗中摸索着，想找到电灯的开关。

sentences.cn: 珍妮特如果早上没有习惯性地喝一杯咖啡的话，就无法开始工作。

trans.cn: 向…致敬；向…欢呼；热情地承认

sentences.cn: 冰雹摧毁了农民种植的小麦。

sentences.cn: 人群高呼他是胜利者。

sentences.cn: 项目由于缺少资金而受阻。

sentences.cn: 当他和新朋友交谈时，他的口吃成了一个障碍。

sentences.cn: 教室外面的交通噪音可能会影响学生们听课的注意力。

sentences.cn: 孵化器的热量帮助孵化小鸡。

sentences.cn: 作为防御措施，他们把城墙又加高了三英尺。

sentences.cn: 政府必须增加对保护国家遗产方面的支出。

sentences.cn: 编辑把手稿中错误的部分用红笔标了出来。

sentences.cn: 我们必须将这起可怕的事故报警。

sentences.cn: 花园浇水用的软管通常在一端有一个喷嘴来帮助其喷水。

sentences.cn: 司机用水管冲洗汽车。

sentences.cn: 当地人派了一辆车把我从机场接了回来，并且对我十分热情。

sentences.cn: 恐怖分子挟制了人质，并威胁要杀了他们。

sentences.cn: 直升飞机在空中盘旋。

sentences.cn: 小女孩睡觉的时候抱着她的玩具兔子。

sentences.cn: 阿道夫·希特勒犯了反人类的滔天罪行。

sentences.cn: 天气又热又闷的时候，湿度会很高。

sentences.cn: 抗议的年轻人向士兵扔石头。

sentences.cn: 龙卷风的风速可超过每小时75英里。

sentences.cn: 科学家的设想在作为真理为人们接受之前，总是要经受其他科学家的考验。

sentences.cn: 我们没法控制这个歇斯底里的人。

sentences.cn: 一根火柴可以点燃整个森林。

sentences.cn: 住在城市里的人通常不了解农村的生活。

sentences.c: Fireworks illuminated the cold night.
sentences.cn: 烟火照亮了寒冷的夜晚。

sentences.cn: 老师讲解了书中有难度的一章，好让学生们清楚地理解。

sentences.cn: 珍妮特错误地以为找工作是一件很容易的事，但是不久她就发现自己错得有多离谱。

sentences.cn: 科幻小说家太有想像力了，他们能创作出前所未有的事物。

sentences.cn: 为了模仿大姑娘，这些十岁的小女孩们已经开始化妆了。

sentences.cn: 接种这种疫苗可使你对这种疾病有两年的免疫力。

sentences.cn: 学校提供教育。

etymology.d: im（进入）+ part（部分）→ 成为（知识的）一部分 → 传授

sentences.cn: 所有种族和民族之间互相尊重、互相理解已经成为这个国家生存的必需因素。

sentences.c: It is an imperative that you take calculus before you start to study advanced economics.
sentences.cn: 在你学习高级经济学之前，你需要学习微积分。

sentences.cn: 宫殿装修得很有皇室风范。

sentences.cn: 珍妮特对另外一种生活的渴望成为了她努力工作的主要动力。

etymology.d: im（进入）+ pet（追求）+ us → 内心追求 → 推动力

sentences.cn: 老板阴沉沉的表情暗示着我们犯了错误。

sentences.cn: 花的图案已经印在了这块布上。

sentences.cn: 这个健康俱乐部开创了一个他们以前从未有过的晨练项目。

sentences.cn: 新任总统举行了盛大的就职仪式。

sentences.cn: 会议将从1月10日持续到2月15日（含2月15日）。

sentences.cn: 这件珠宝本身很便宜，但由于它曾属于一位电影明星，所以实际价值很高。

sentences.cn: 珍妮特决定戒烟，因为抽烟危害了她的健康。

sentences.c: She put her camera in a waterproof bag so it wouldn't get wet.
sentences.cn: 她把相机放进防水包里防止被打湿。

sentences.c: He has a whim for reading suddenly.
sentences.cn: 他突然心血来潮想看书。

sentences.c: The weary workers walked slowly toward the train station after work.
sentences.cn: 下班后，疲倦的工人们步履缓慢地朝火车站走去。

etymology.d: 来自名词 wear（磨损，消耗）+ y → 身体被磨损的 → 疲倦的

sentences.c: A loom is used to weave cloth.
sentences.cn: 织布机用是来织布的。

sentences.c: He put one knee on the ground and asked her to wed him.
sentences.cn: 他单膝跪地，向她求婚。

sentences.c: The quarrel drove a wedge between him and his relatives.
sentences.cn: 吵架使他和他的亲人之间产生了裂痕。

sentences.c: He wedged himself through the crowd to get a glimpse of the movie star.
sentences.cn: 他挤进人群瞥见了那位电影明星。

trans.cn: （食物）有益健康的；有益身心健康的，增进身心健康的；（显得）健康的，朝气蓬勃的

sentences.c: The food we got at school was simple but wholesome.
sentences.cn: 我们在学校买的食物虽然简单，但是有益健康。

sentences.c: The conservation research project will concentrate on the wildlife habitats in the forest.（
sentences.cn: 动物）保护研究项目将关注森林野生动物的习性。

sentences.c: I forgot to water my plant and it withered.
sentences.cn: 我忘给植物浇水，它都枯萎了。

etymology.d: with（和…一起）+ er（可以记为“饿”）→ 和饿在一起久了就会枯萎 → 枯萎

sentences.c: The bank withheld the deposit until he paid back his debt.
sentences.cn: 银行冻结了他的财产，直到他偿还完借款。

sentences.c: The bride wore a wreath on her head at the wedding.
sentences.cn: 婚礼上，新娘头戴花环。

sentences.c: With a powerful wrench, I removed the lid from the pickle jar.
sentences.cn: 我用了个强有力的扳手，打开了泡菜坛上的盖子。

sentences.c: The shirt has many wrinkles and should be ironed.
sentences.cn: 衬衫上有许多褶皱，应该熨一下。

sentences.c: The patient let out a yell of pain when the doctor touched his broken bone.
sentences.cn: 当医生碰到病人的骨折处时，病人发出了痛苦的叫声。

sentences.c: The youngster listened respectfully to his grandfather's stories.
sentences.cn: 年轻人恭敬地听着祖父的故事。

sentences.c: Bill Clinton reached the zenith of his career in 1992. 1992
sentences.cn: 年，比尔·克林顿到达了事业的顶峰。

sentences.c: The factory was built in an industrial zone.
sentences.cn: 那座工厂建在工业园区。
